svg.text: WeatherGPT — End-to-End Meteorological Intelligence, Hazard Synthesis & Decision Support Platform

g.text: TIER 1: MULTI-MODAL DATA SOURCES (METEOROLOGICAL, HYDROLOGICAL & HAZARD TELEMETRY)
TIER 2: DATA INGESTION GATEWAY & QUALITY VALIDATION ENGINE
TIER 3: WEATHER INTELLIGENCE ENGINE & MULTI-SOURCE FUSION
Rainfall Probability & Accumulation (mm) • 2m Temperature & Heat Index
10m Wind Speed, Gusts & Direction • Surface RH% • Barometric MSLP (hPa)
TIER 4B: MULTI-HAZARD RISK ANALYSIS & THRESHOLD DETECTOR
Heavy Rainfall Risk ≠ Flood Risk (Drainage basin, slope, saturation & river telemetry required)
Alert Severity Mapping: GREEN (Normal) • YELLOW (Watch) • ORANGE (Alert) • RED (Take Action)
TIER 5: CANONICAL WEATHER SNAPSHOT (SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH CONTRACT)
Deterministic Model: 1 Location + 1 Valid Timestamp = Identical Data Across All UI & Services
TIER 6: AI INTELLIGENCE, EXPLANATION & CONVERSATIONAL ADVISORY (GEMINI / KRISHI)
CRITICAL: Gemini is the Explanation Layer — NOT the Meteorological Source (Zero Hallucination)
Translates Complex Data to Plain Text
TIER 7: APPLICATION MODULES & CITIZEN/ENTERPRISE DELIVERY CHANNELS
WeatherGPT | SIH 2026 | PS-68 | Ministry of Earth Sciences
